body.en: In English there are some specific words which denote only a man or only a woman, or both, or which, denoting neither of them, denote some other inanimate thing. These words are called Gender. Since gender is a notable topic of English grammar, it is discussed here in detail.

body.mix: Gender পরিবর্তন হয়ে থাকে সাধারণত Masculine থেকে Feminine বা Feminine থেকে Masculine। আর সম্পূর্ণ ভিন্ন শব্দ ব্যবহার করে অধিকাংশ ক্ষেত্রে এ পরিবর্তন করা হয়। যেমন— Bachelor (অবিবাহিত পুরুষ)—Spinster/Maid (অবিবাহিতা স্ত্রীলোক), Beau (সুন্দর পুরুষ)—Belle (সুন্দর নারী), Boar (শূকর)—Sow (শূকরী), Brother (ভাই)—Sister (বোন), Buck (হরিণ)—Doe (হরিণী), Drake (পাতিহাঁস)—Duck (পাতিহাঁসী), Drone (পুং মৌমাছি)—Bee (স্ত্রী মৌমাছি), Gander (রাজহংস)—Goose (রাজহংসী), Lad (বালক)—Lass (বালিকা), Monk, Friar (মঠবাসী)—Nun (মঠবাসিনী), Sloven (নোংরা ও অগোছালো পুরুষ)—Slut (নোংরা ও অগোছালো মহিলা), Stag (হরিণ)—Hind (হরিণী), Swain (নাগর)—Nymph (রূপসী নারী), Tailor (দর্জি)—Seamstress (মহিলা দর্জি), Wizard (যাদুকর)—Witch (যাদুকরী)।
body.en: Gender is generally changed from masculine to feminine or from feminine to masculine. And in most cases this change is made by using a completely different word. body.en: There are some masculine nouns from which feminine nouns can be formed by adding 'ess' at the end without changing the root word. For example — Author (author)—Authoress (authoress), God (god)—Goddess (goddess), Heir (heir)—Heiress (heiress), Host (host)—Hostess (hostess), Lion (lion)—Lioness (lioness), Manager (manager)—Manageress (woman manager), Patron (patron)—Patroness (patroness), Poet (poet)—Poetess (woman poet), Prince (prince)—Princess (princess).

body.mix: যেসব Masculine gender-এর শেষে or, er, ro, ary রয়েছে, তাদেরকে Feminine gender-এ পরিবর্তিত করার জন্য e, o, a উঠিয়ে দিয়ে r-এর পর ess যোগ করতে হয়। যেমন— Actor (অভিনেতা)—Actress (অভিনেত্রী), Emperor (সম্রাট)—Empress (সম্রাজ্ঞী), Governor (অভিভাবক)—Governess (অভিভাবিকা), Hunter (পুরুষ শিকারি)—Huntress (মহিলা শিকারি), Tiger (বাঘ)—Tigress (বাঘিনী), Tutor (শিক্ষক)—Tutress (শিক্ষিকা), Waiter (পরিচারক)—Waitress (পরিচারিকা)।
body.en: For masculine genders ending in 'or', 'er', 'ro' or 'ary', to change them into the feminine gender, the 'e', 'o' or 'a' must be dropped and 'ess' added after 'r'. For example — Actor (actor)—Actress (actress), Emperor (emperor)—Empress (empress), Governor (guardian)—Governess (governess), Hunter (male hunter)—Huntress (woman hunter), Tiger (tiger)—Tigress (tigress), Tutor (teacher)—Tutress (woman teacher), Waiter (waiter)—Waitress (waitress).

body.mix: Compound noun-এর masculine অংশকে feminine-এ রূপান্তর করে gender পরিবর্তন করা যায়। এই পরিবর্তন compound noun-এর প্রথম অংশে বা দ্বিতীয় অংশে হতে পারে। যেমন— Boy-baby (ছেলে শিশু)—Girl-baby (মেয়ে শিশু), Billy-goat (পাঠা)—Nanny-goat (পাঠী), Father-in-law (শ্বশুর)—Mother-in-law (শাশুড়ি), Fisherman (জেলে)—Fisherwoman (জেলেনি), Jack-ass (পুরুষ গাধা)—She-ass (মাদী গাধা), Milk-man (গোয়ালা)—Milk-maid (গোয়ালিনী), Peacock (ময়ূর)—Peahen (ময়ূরী)।
body.en: Gender can be changed by turning the masculine part of a compound noun into the feminine. This change may take place in the first part or in the second part of the compound noun. For example — Boy-baby (boy baby)—Girl-baby (girl baby), Billy-goat (he-goat)—Nanny-goat (she-goat), Father-in-law (father-in-law)—Mother-in-law (mother-in-law), Fisherman (fisherman)—Fisherwoman (fisherwoman), Jack-ass (male ass)—She-ass (female ass), Milk-man (milkman)—Milk-maid (milkmaid), Peacock (peacock)—Peahen (peahen).
